descripcion_geo: Valley north of Jericho, near the Dead Sea. Place of judgment on Achan and the door of messianic hope according to Hosea.
importancia_estrategica: Valley of turmoil and door of hope; where sin was judged and hope promised.

historias.titulo: The judgment of Achan in the Valley of Achor
historias.descripcion: Achan, who stole from Jericho's anathema, is discovered; all Israel stones him in the valley of Achor.

historias.titulo: The Valley of Achor as a door of hope
historias.descripcion: Hosea prophesies that in the restoration God will turn the valley of Achor ('turbance') into a door of hope.

historias.titulo: The Valley of Achor in the heritage of Judah
historias.descripcion: The Valley of Achor marked the northern limit of Judah's inheritance.

personajes.descripcion: He stole from Jericho's anathema and caused Israel's defeat at Hai; He was executed in the Valley of Achor.
He presided over the trial of Achan; The place was called Achor (disturbance) in his memory.
He promised that the valley of judgment (Achor) would become a door of hope in restoration.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Valley of Achor: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: The Valley of Achor ('turbation') was the scene of the judgment on the sin of Achan; Hosea makes it a symbol of restoration: the place of failure becomes a door of hope.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Valley of Achor ('turbation') was the scene of the judgment on the sin of Achan; Hosea makes it a symbol of restoration: the place of failure becomes a door of hope.
